spots.name: Town Square
spots.scene: The fountain is running. Notices flutter on the board by the well, and someone is always arguing about a floor.

spots.name: Market Row
spots.scene: Awnings, crates, and Hesta calling prices over the lane. The cat is usually on the awning.

spots.name: The Old Inn
spots.scene: Warm bread, wet cloaks, and Maelin pretending she does not listen to every story.

spots.name: Guild Hall
spots.scene: Five banners, one door, and Sera's desk under the job board. Your hall's three slips are nailed here. Another banner has a different three.

spots.name: Job Yard
spots.scene: Pegs, chalk, and Fenn sorting who is late for a shift. This is day work, not the guild board.

spots.name: The Pier
spots.scene: Salt, rope, and Pike mending a net he will swear is fine.

spots.name: Home Street
spots.scene: Tents, cottages, and smoke from kitchens. Wren sits on a step and watches who comes home.

spots.name: The Kitchen
spots.scene: Steam, a shouting pot, and Bram who will not let a burnt stew leave the door.

spots.name: Pet Store
spots.scene: Cages, straw, and Lila talking to something that answers.

spots.name: The Counting House
spots.scene: Quiet coin, iron bars, and Voss who counts twice and then once more.

spots.name: South Orchard
spots.scene: Low trees past the last house. Mira says the cats own this place more than she does.

spots.name: Lantern Alley
spots.scene: Narrow, lamp-lit, and always one child who knows a shortcut the map does not.

spots.name: River Road
spots.scene: The road out of town follows the water. Nell waits where the lamps stop.

spots.name: West Fields
spots.scene: Stubble, a broken fence, and Bren watching the tower road for what walks off it.

spots.name: Chapel of the First Stair
spots.scene: A small chapel for people who came back. Nia keeps the candles and does not ask what you saw.

spots.name: North Gate
spots.scene: The town gate, a chalk mark for the day, and Holt who wants names more than stories.

spots.name: The Town Well
spots.scene: The bucket sticks. Tam has been saying he will fix it since before you arrived.

spots.name: The Stables
spots.scene: Straw, leather, and Tess who talks to the horses like they pay rent.

spots.name: East Watch
spots.scene: A wooden watch over the fields. Yenn can see the tower road and pretends that helps.

spots.name: The Quarry Mouth
spots.scene: The town side of the mine. Dorr will not let you call a whistle a rescue.

npcs.name: Rowan
npcs.title: town clerk
npcs.line: If it happened in the square, Rowan already wrote it down. If it did not, he will still have an opinion.

npcs.name: Pipp
npcs.title: crier
npcs.line: Pipp shouts your hall's three slips whether anyone asked or not. He does not shout another hall's.

npcs.name: Hesta
npcs.title: market keeper
npcs.line: Coin on the counter, goods off the shelf. Hesta does not do credit, and she does not do haste.

npcs.name: Maelin
npcs.title: innkeeper
npcs.line: Maelin keeps a bed, a bowl, and a longer memory than the guild ledger.

npcs.name: Sera
npcs.title: board clerk
npcs.line: Sera nails three slips for your hall at dawn and takes them down at midnight. Another banner does not see yours.

npcs.name: Fenn
npcs.title: yard master
npcs.line: Fenn pays for a shift, not a story. The guild board is next door, and he is glad it is not his.

npcs.name: Pike
npcs.title: net mender
npcs.line: Pike has been mending the same net for a week. He says the sea can wait.

npcs.name: Wren
npcs.title: neighbor
npcs.line: Wren knows which chimneys are lit and which doors have not opened since yesterday.

npcs.name: Bram
npcs.title: cook
npcs.line: Bram feeds whoever comes in hungry and scolds whoever comes in late.

npcs.name: Lila
npcs.title: beast keeper
npcs.line: Lila names every animal in the shop and most of the ones that are not.

npcs.name: Voss
npcs.title: teller
npcs.line: Voss speaks softly because coin is loud enough.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.title: orchard keeper
npcs.line: Mira keeps the trees. The cats keep Mira.

npcs.name: Kit
npcs.title: alley runner
npcs.line: Kit runs messages for bread and will not say whose.

npcs.name: Nell
npcs.title: road villager
npcs.line: Nell was walking home when the lamps ran out. She is still walking.

npcs.name: Bren
npcs.title: field watch
npcs.line: Bren counts what comes off the tower road. He does not like the number.

npcs.name: Nia
npcs.title: chapel keeper
npcs.line: Nia lights a candle for anyone who asks and does not write the name down.

npcs.name: Holt
npcs.title: gate warden
npcs.line: Holt wants the gate chalked, the watch awake, and the road quiet.

npcs.name: Tam
npcs.title: well keeper
npcs.line: Tam has a wrench, a complaint, and a bucket that hates both.

npcs.name: Tess
npcs.title: stable groom
npcs.line: Tess says the horses know who is lying. She has not been wrong in a way you can prove.

npcs.name: Yenn
npcs.title: east scout
npcs.line: Yenn sees farther than she can help. She still rings the bell.

npcs.name: Dorr
npcs.title: quarry boss
npcs.line: Dorr counts workers the way other people count coin. A missing whistle is a missing person.
